profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at HARMAN International
profile.summary:
Experience in software development, designing and developing various broadcast applications for Samsung Smart TV (Linux-based Tizen OS). Expertise includes analyzing country specification/requirements, object oriented designing and implementing, from initial design to code-level implementation running on millions Smart TVs.

Experience in software project management, outsourcing and supervision. 
Good knowledge of 3D Computer vision, image processing and object recognition. 
Designed, implemented and published various mobile apps on Apple App Store and Google Play Store. 

#iOS #BLE #Flutter #RubyOnRails #Cloud #SoftwareDevelopment #MobileDevelopment #ComputerVision #EmbeddedSystem #DTV #DVB #ATSC #Broadcast

positions.description:
Designing, developing core applications for Samsung Smart TV.
Includes: Channel List, Closed Caption (ATSC), Subtitle (DVB), Early Warning Broadcast System, EWS, TVViewer, bixby voice control, Core-app services.
positions.insights: Skills: Debugging · Software Requirements · Communication · Coaching & Mentoring · Code Review · Problem Solving

positions.title: Researcher
positions.description: Project: Developed a 3D line feature extraction based on fuzzy clustering algorithm called “Self-organizing fuzzy k-means”. Based on the 2D lines feature and 3D point clouds information, plus the clustering algorithm on 3D points cloud, it can extract the 3D line from stereo camera, and we can use 3D line feature for 3D object recog- nition, 3D plane identification applied in scene understanding and modeling.

positions.title: Research intern
positions.description:
Automating Graphics and Navigators Test (ANG module), internship at Panasonic R&D Center Vietnam
Project: Developed an Automating Graphics and Navigators Test for MHP devices, full automatically, save test time and exactly. The whole system is developed in Linux, it’s for testing the display functionality of DTV automatically using image processing.
